Every boat in our fleet comes with a licensed skipper, so you don't need any paperwork. Prices start at €749 for two hours on the Astondoa 40, and all charters include fuel, drinks, snacks, and 21% VAT.

Our 2028 Price Tiers at a Glance

We keep pricing simple. Boats split into two tiers, with all others quoted individually via WhatsApp. All prices include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and VAT (IVA 21%).

Our most popular no-license options. The Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) and Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) both depart from Puerto Banús. Prices are fixed: €749 for 2 hours, €1,299 for 4 hours, €1,799 for 6 hours, and €2,299 for 8 hours. Perfect for a sunset cruise to Cabopino or a day trip to Cala del Faro.

The Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) — available in white and grey — is our premium no-license option. Minimum charter is 4 hours at €4,719, and that includes a free jet ski. Ideal for larger groups wanting space, speed, and style along the Golden Mile to Estepona.

Other Boats: Custom Quotes via WhatsApp

Our remaining fleet — from the Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) to the Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) — is priced on request. Contact us on WhatsApp for a personalised quote. Every booking includes the same all-inclusive package: skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and VAT.

What's Included in Every Charter

No add-ons, no surprises. Your price covers:

Why Rent Without a License in Marbella?

Marbella's coastline — from Puerto Banús to Sotogrande — is best explored by boat. With a skipper included, you relax, swim at Cala Cortés, anchor off the Marbella Marina, or cruise past La Concha. No paperwork, no stress.

How to Book for 2028

Reserve your preferred boat via our website or WhatsApp. We recommend booking at least 48 hours ahead, especially for July and August. For Tier A boats, payment secures your slot. For other vessels, we'll confirm availability and send a quote within hours.
